card.name: Digit 1 in the middle of numbers
card.fires_on: The second digit "1" inside a multi-digit number, mostly in ISBNs, Bible chapter and verse references, page ranges and dates. It fires weakly on a few place or company names such as Kinder Morgan and Shetland.

modes.label: Digit 1 in scripture references
modes.description: The final "1" of a chapter number like 11 or 51 right before a colon and verse numbers.

modes.label: Digit 1 in ISBNs and page numbers
modes.description: A "1" inside a longer catalog number or page range.

modes.label: Version or date numbers
modes.description: A "1" in the second place of a version or day number.

card.plain: It marks the digit 1 sitting inside a bigger number, such as a Bible verse reference, ISBN or page range.
